ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff / Sapphire Sleet fake-meeting / recruiter installer chain (msiexec spawning LOLBin from crypto/VC-themed package)
ucs.description: Catches the Sapphire Sleet (Bluenoroff sub-cluster) recruiter / VC lure: a victim clicks a LinkedIn DM or email link, downloads a 'Zoom/Teams/Skype/portfolio/wallet' MSI or EXE installer from attacker-controlled infrastructure, and the installer spawns a script interpreter or download LOLBin to pull the second-stage Rust/.NET implant. Microsoft and Kaspersky have repeatedly documented this exact install-chain for AppleJeus, RustBucket and the 2023-2025 Sapphire Sleet campaigns.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_hash) as child_hash values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="msiexec.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="installer.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="setup.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="update.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe") AND (match(Processes.parent_process,"(?i)(zoom|teams|skype|webex|meeting|wallet|crypto|blockchain|defi|coin|token|trading|trade|invest|venture|capital|portfolio|recruit|interview)") OR match(Processes.parent_process,"(?i)\\\\(Users|ProgramData|Public)\\\\.*\\\\(Downloads|Temp|Desktop)\\\\")) AND Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe"]);
let installers = dynamic(["msiexec.exe","installer.exe","setup.exe","update.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (installers)
| where FileName in~ (suspicious_children)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(zoom|teams|skype|webex|meeting|wallet|crypto|blockchain|defi|coin|token|trading|trade|invest|venture|capital|portfolio|recruit|interview)"
   or InitiatingProcessFolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\(Users|ProgramData|Public)\\.*\\(Downloads|Temp|Desktop)\\"
| extend SecondStageIndicators = extract_all(@"(?i)(https?://[^\s\"']+|invoke-expression|iex\b|downloadstring|downloadfile|new-object\s+net\.webclient|certutil\s+-urlcache|bitsadmin\s+/transfer|curl\s+[-]?[oOL])", ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          ParentImage=InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage=FolderPath, ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, SecondStageIndicators
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let installers = dynamic(["msiexec.exe","installer.exe","setup.exe","update.exe"]);
let suspicious_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","mshta.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, '\\')[-1])),
         ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| where ParentName in (installers) and ChildName in (suspicious_children)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(Users|ProgramData|Public)\\.*\\(Downloads|Temp|Desktop)\\"
   or ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)(zoom|teams|skype|webex|meeting|wallet|crypto|blockchain|defi|coin|token|trading|trade|invest|venture|capital|portfolio|recruit|interview)"
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(https?://|invoke-expression|\biex\b|downloadstring|downloadfile|new-object\s+net\.webclient|certutil\s+-urlcache|bitsadmin\s+/transfer|curl\s+[-]?[oOL])"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Bluenoroff/Sapphire Sleet Fake Meeting or Recruiter Installer Spawning Script Interpreter
id: e7a8b3c2-5d1f-4b2a-9c3e-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects msiexec/installer/setup binaries (typically downloaded from attacker-controlled recruiter-themed infra) spawning a script interpreter or download LOLBin while the parent path or command line references meeting-software / cryptocurrency / VC / recruiter themes, matching the Bluenoroff (Sapphire Sleet / APT38 / TA444) installer kill chain documented by Microsoft, Kaspersky and Mandiant.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/11/22/sapphire-sleet-targets-cryptocurrency-firms/
  - https://securelist.com/the-bluenoroff-cryptocurrency-hunt-is-still-on/105488/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0098/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1566.002
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.007
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0098
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_installer:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\installer.exe'
      - '\setup.exe'
      - '\update.exe'
  child_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
  themed_parent_path_or_cmd:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
      - zoom
      - teams
      - skype
      - webex
      - meeting
      - wallet
      - crypto
      - blockchain
      - defi
      - trading
      - capital
      - venture
      - invest
      - portfolio
      - recruit
      - interview
  themed_parent_dir:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Desktop\'
      - '\Public\'
  condition: parent_installer and child_lolbin and (themed_parent_path_or_cmd or themed_parent_dir)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate enterprise application installers that chain post-install configuration scripts (validate signer and origin URL)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\installer.exe OR *\\Installer.exe OR *\\setup.exe OR *\\Setup.exe OR *\\update.exe OR *\\Update.exe) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\wscript.exe) (@ParentCommandLine:(*zoom* OR *Zoom* OR *teams* OR *Teams* OR *skype* OR *Skype* OR *webex* OR *Webex* OR *meeting* OR *Meeting* OR *wallet* OR *Wallet* OR *crypto* OR *Crypto* OR *blockchain* OR *Blockchain* OR *defi* OR *DeFi* OR *trading* OR *Trading* OR *capital* OR *Capital* OR *venture* OR *Venture* OR *invest* OR *Invest* OR *portfolio* OR *Portfolio* OR *recruit* OR *Recruit* OR *interview* OR *Interview*) OR @ParentImage:(*\\Downloads\\* OR *\\downloads\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\temp\\* OR *\\Desktop\\* OR *\\desktop\\* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\public\\*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(msiexec|installer|setup|update)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|curl|certutil|bitsadmin|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|cscript|wscript)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(zoom|teams|skype|webex|meeting|wallet|crypto|blockchain|defi|coin|token|trading|invest|venture|capital|portfolio|recruit|interview)", field=ParentImageFileName) OR regex("(?i)\\\\(Downloads|Temp|Desktop|Public)\\\\", field=ParentImageFileName) OR regex("(?i)(https?://|invoke-expression|\\biex\\b|downloadstring|downloadfile|new-object|certutil\\s+-urlcache|bitsadmin\\s+/transfer)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/

ucs.title: [LLM] Bluenoroff / APT38 AppleJeus persistence: Run-key pointing at user-writable cryptocurrency-themed binary
ucs.description: Catches Bluenoroff's signature persistence step from the AppleJeus / SnatchCrypto / Sapphire Sleet families: after the trojanized 'crypto trader' or 'wallet' installer drops its payload to AppData or ProgramData, it writes a HKCU/HKLM Run or RunOnce value pointing back at that user-writable cryptocurrency-themed binary. The combination of (Run-key autostart) + (user-writable directory) + (cryptocurrency/wallet/trading naming OR one of the known trojanized product names) is highly specific to this actor and very low-volume in normal environments.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.user) as user values(Registry.process_name) as writer_process values(Registry.registry_value_data) as reg_value_data from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where (Registry.registry_path="*\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\Image File Execution Options\\*") AND match(Registry.registry_value_data,"(?i)\\\\(AppData\\\\(Local|Roaming)|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public)\\\\.*\\.(exe|dll|scr)") AND (match(Registry.registry_value_data,"(?i)(wallet|crypto|trade|trading|defi|coin|block|swap|exchange|invest|portfolio|token|chain|miner|node)") OR match(Registry.registry_value_data,"(?i)(celas[\\s_-]?trade|jmt[\\s_-]?trading|unioncrypto|kupay|alticgo|esilet|cryptoneuro|tradr|alpha\\s?cash)")) AND Registry.user!="*$" by Registry.dest Registry.registry_key_name Registry.registry_value_name Registry.action | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where ActionType in~ ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has_any (@"\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\CurrentVersion\RunOnce", @"\Image File Execution Options")
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData\\(Local|Roaming)|ProgramData|Users\\Public)\\.*\.(exe|dll|scr)"
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(wallet|crypto|trade|trading|defi|coin|block|swap|exchange|invest|portfolio|token|chain|miner|node)"
    or RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(celas[\s_-]?trade|jmt[\s_-]?trading|unioncrypto|kupay|alticgo|esilet|cryptoneuro|tradr|alpha[\s_]?cash)"
    or RegistryValueName matches regex @"(?i)(celas|jmt|unioncrypto|kupay|alticgo|esilet|cryptoneuro)"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend BinaryPath = extract(@"(?i)([a-z]:\\[^\"\s]+\.(?:exe|dll|scr))", 1, RegistryValueData)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | project ChildProcTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, BinaryPath=FolderPath, BinarySHA256=SHA256, BinarySigner=ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName, BinaryProduct=ProcessVersionInfoProductName
    ) on DeviceId, BinaryPath
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, BinaryPath, BinarySHA256, BinarySigner, BinaryProduct,
          WriterProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName, WriterCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RegistryValueData
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventType =~ "RegistryValueSet"
| where RegistryKey matches regex @"(?i)\\CurrentVersion\\Run(Once)?\\"
   or RegistryKey matches regex @"(?i)\\Image File Execution Options\\"
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData\\(Local|Roaming)|ProgramData|Users\\Public)\\.*\.(exe|dll|scr)"
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(wallet|crypto|trade|trading|defi|coin|block|swap|exchange|invest|portfolio|token|chain|miner|node)"
    or RegistryValueData matches regex @"(?i)(celas[\s_-]?trade|jmt[\s_-]?trading|unioncrypto|kupay|alticgo|esilet|cryptoneuro|tradr|alpha[\s_]?cash)"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend BinaryPath = extract(@"(?i)([a-z]:\\[^\"\s]+\.(?:exe|dll|scr))", 1, RegistryValueData)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, RegistryKey, RegistryValue, BinaryPath, RegistryValueData, WriterProcess=ActingProcessName, WriterCmd=ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Bluenoroff/APT38 AppleJeus Persistence via Run Key Pointing to User-Writable Crypto-Themed Binary
id: f8b9c4d3-6e2a-5c3b-ad4f-2b3c4d5e6f70
status: experimental
description: Detects Bluenoroff (APT38 / Stardust Chollima / TA444 / Sapphire Sleet) AppleJeus and SnatchCrypto family persistence — a Run / RunOnce / IFEO registry value is written pointing to an executable in AppData, ProgramData or Users\Public whose path or name references cryptocurrency, wallet, trading, or one of the known trojanized product names (Celas Trade Pro, JMT Trading, Union Crypto Trader, Kupay Wallet, AlticGo, Esilet, CryptoNeuro). Documented by CISA AA20-239A, Kaspersky GReAT, Microsoft Threat Intelligence, and Jamf (RustBucket).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa20-239a
  - https://securelist.com/operation-applejeus-sequel/95596/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/11/22/sapphire-sleet-targets-cryptocurrency-firms/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1547.001
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.t1112
  - attack.g0098
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: registry_set
detection:
  runkey:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\CurrentVersion\Run\'
      - '\CurrentVersion\RunOnce\'
      - '\Image File Execution Options\'
  user_writable_path:
    Details|contains:
      - '\AppData\Local\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
  crypto_theme:
    Details|contains:
      - wallet
      - crypto
      - trading
      - trade
      - defi
      - coin
      - token
      - block
      - swap
      - exchange
      - portfolio
      - chain
      - miner
  trojanized_product:
    Details|contains:
      - celas
      - 'jmt trading'
      - jmttrading
      - unioncrypto
      - kupay
      - alticgo
      - esilet
      - cryptoneuro
      - alphacash
  condition: runkey and user_writable_path and (crypto_theme or trojanized_product)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate cryptocurrency wallet/trader installations (validate Authenticode signer and reputation of the dropped binary)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\* OR *\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\* OR *\\currentversion\\run\\* OR *\\Image File Execution Options\\*) @Details:((*\\AppData\\Local\\* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\* OR *\\appdata\\local\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\*) AND (*wallet* OR *Wallet* OR *crypto* OR *Crypto* OR *trading* OR *Trading* OR *trade* OR *Trade* OR *defi* OR *DeFi* OR *coin* OR *Coin* OR *token* OR *Token* OR *block* OR *Block* OR *swap* OR *Swap* OR *exchange* OR *Exchange* OR *portfolio* OR *Portfolio* OR *celas* OR *Celas* OR *jmttrading* OR *JMTTrading* OR *unioncrypto* OR *UnionCrypto* OR *kupay* OR *Kupay* OR *alticgo* OR *AlticGo* OR *esilet* OR *Esilet* OR *cryptoneuro* OR *CryptoNeuro* OR *alphacash* OR *AlphaCash*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate RegObjectName=/\\CurrentVersion\\Run(Once)?\\|\\Image File Execution Options\\/i
| regex("(?i)\\\\(AppData\\\\(Local|Roaming)|ProgramData|Users\\\\Public)\\\\.*\\.(exe|dll|scr)", field=RegStringValue)
| regex("(?i)(wallet|crypto|trade|trading|defi|coin|token|block|swap|exchange|portfolio|chain|miner|celas|jmttrading|unioncrypto|kupay|alticgo|esilet|cryptoneuro|alphacash)", field=RegStringValue)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue, ContextImageFileName], function=count())
